{07 16 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 06 00}Ma tean,
et see on äkiline, {01 00 00 05 00}aga ma

{07 19 00}See pole sinu asi,{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 1b 00}aga

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, hey, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}. {07 14 00}I know
it's sudden, but I'm moving,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1b 00}I'm not chasing a boy or
anything foolish like that.{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}
Don't you worry!

{07 04 00}Oi, hei, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}. {07 14 00}Tean,
et on äkiline, aga ma kolin,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1b 00}Ma ei aja taga poissi ega
midagi nii rumalat.{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}
Ära muretse!

{07 04 00}Tere, {04 1f 00}!{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00} Kuule,

{07 15 00}Saada mind parem ära

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Thanks for everything!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 17 00}I
hope you find love soon,
too, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Aitäh kõige eest!{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 17 00}Loodan,
et sinagi leiad varsti
armastuse, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Don't make that face!{01 01 00} {07 06 00}I
don't want to remember you
with that ugly, sad face!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ära tee sellist nägu!{01 01 00} {07 06 00}Ma
ei taha sind mäletada
selle inetu kurva näoga!

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Don't try to stop me!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 06 00}My life depends on it!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Ära üritagi mind peatada!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 06 00}Mu elu sõltub sellest!

{07 1b 00}Ohoo{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 15 00}Kas ma tõesti
meeldin sulle nii väga?{02 01 00 0e 0f 10}
Jah! Jah, meeldid!
Ee...
Jah. Ma mõtlen, ei.

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Stop!{01 00 00 0a 00} Don't say stuff like
that, OK?!

{07 06 00}I won't be able to get away
from this place if you keep
saying that, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 02 00}Lõpeta!{01 00 00 0a 00} Ära ütle selliseid
asju, eks?!

{07 06 00}Ma ei suuda siit ära minna,
kui sa seda kogu aeg
ütled, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}If we got more visitors,{01 00 00 0a 00}

{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
